data.name: مُبَشِّر

data.long_meaning: من يحمل رسالة الأمل والتفاؤل والبشارة للآخرين. The name مُبَشِّر carries the meaning “Bringer of Good News” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Parents who choose مُبَشِّر usually hope their child will grow to embody bringer of good news and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_arabic.name: مُبَشِّر

in_urdu.name: مُبَشِّر

in_hindi.name: मुबश्शिर

in_pashto.name: مبشر

Additionally, the name Mubashir is a reminder of the importance of spreading positivity and good news in the community.
